package.description: A visual diff tool with syntax-aware diffing, directory comparison, and three-way merge support

en-US.description: A visual diff tool with syntax-aware diffing, directory comparison, and three-way merge support
en-US.longDescription: Differ is a modern desktop application for file comparison and merging. It supports side-by-side diff with syntax highlighting, three-way merge with conflict detection, recursive directory comparison, and AST-based syntax-aware hunk regrouping.
en-US.name: Differ
